This project is HuntDialed Prospector — a tool that drafts value-first replies to hunter forum/Reddit threads for Jeff to manually post (never auto-scans or auto-posts, keeping the account ToS-safe).

Main entry points:
- `quickdraft.py` — paste a thread, get a relevance read + draft copied to clipboard and logged
- `draft.py` — prompt guardrails and prompt-injection fencing
- `score.py` — relevance scoring
- `models.py` — data models

Tests: `python3 -m pytest` (19 tests)
